question: What age range is specified for the womb in relation to generation or birth?
premises: The lower limit is more than twelve years.
The womb is said to generate within this range.
inference: Generation is associated with a womb from over twelve years up to sixty.
uncertainties: prajāyate may refer to giving birth or to being fit for generation.
plain_english: A womb more than twelve years old, up to sixty, is capable of giving birth.
